overview: A U.S.-only pro se workspace for federal habeas corpus work under 28 U.S.C. §2254, with a case-file library, grounded legal drafting, citation checking and DOCX export.
features: Create habeas projects and upload PDF, DOCX and TXT case files
Automatic indexing of every upload with page and paragraph locators
Ask questions answered only from your own case files, with expandable source passages
Draft petitions, memoranda, motions, replies and exhaustion notices with autosave and version history
Citation checker that marks each citation verified, unverified or malformed
Grounding check that flags claims with no supporting source
Export any draft to DOCX with caption, numbered paragraphs and a source appendix
Bring your own model key, stored securely and shown only by its last four characters
